zh.title: 瑞典派 Gripen 戰機支援 NATO 波蘭防空任務　保護援烏後勤樞紐
zh.summary: 戰機將納入 NATO 整合防空與飛彈防禦，主要由瑞典基地出動，並在波蘭設置較小的前進作業據點。
body: 瑞典政府於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布，自 10 月 1 日起派遣 JAS 39 Gripen 戰機支援 NATO 在波蘭的防空任務。任務重點包括保護波蘭東南部一處運送軍民援助物資前往烏克蘭的後勤樞紐。
Gripen 將納入 NATO 整合防空與飛彈防禦體系。大部分戰機與人員主要留駐瑞典，並在波蘭設置規模較小的前進作業據點，以支援任務調度。
瑞典政府公告沒有公布參與戰機架數，因此無法據此推算固定部署規模。這項任務是 NATO 防空貢獻，公告也沒有表示瑞典戰機將進入烏克蘭領空執行作戰。

en.title: Sweden assigns Gripen fighter aircraft to NATO air-defense mission in Poland
en.summary: The aircraft will support NATO integrated air and missile defense and protect a logistics hub used for aid to Ukraine.
body: The Swedish government announced on September 30, 2026 that JAS 39 Gripen fighters would begin supporting a NATO air-defense mission in Poland on October 1. The task includes protecting a logistics hub in southeastern Poland used to move military and civilian assistance to Ukraine.
The Gripens will contribute to NATO's integrated air and missile defense. Most aircraft and personnel will remain based in Sweden, supported by a smaller forward operating location in Poland.

The government announcement did not disclose the number of aircraft, so no fixed deployment strength can be inferred. It describes a NATO air-defense contribution and does not state that Swedish fighters will conduct combat missions inside Ukrainian airspace.

facts.claim: Sweden's Gripen contribution to NATO air defense in Poland begins on 2026-10-01.
The mission protects a logistics hub in southeastern Poland used for military and civilian support to Ukraine.
Most aircraft remain based in Sweden with a smaller forward operating location in Poland; the aircraft count was not disclosed.
